@aiden0z/pptx-renderer 1.4.0 standalone browser ESM bundle.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aiden0z/pptx-renderer
License: Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).

This local bundle parses the uploaded .pptx and renders its original OOXML
slides (master/layout inheritance, theme colours, text, images, groups and
tables) as DOM/SVG. No CDN or external font service is used. EduPlay only uses
the source file as the presentation source; speaker notes remain server-side.
